description: Glyphchemy, a bespoke Morphe patch collection for Gboard: this project's own patches, the Gboard port of JohninNL's nl-morphe-patches, the jasonwu1994 Gboard-patches set, and kveld9's Gboard privacy/hardening patches (tracker blocking, offline mode, permissions, remote-update blocking and more) — de-duplicated and all targeting Gboard 18.6.3.1002251336-release-arm64-v8a, the only build these patches have been applied against. The armeabi-v7a split is not supported.
